blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Supreme Court Associate Justice Rodil Zalameda, a contender for the chief justice post, said public officials responsible for increasing unprogrammed appropriations under the national budget should be presumed to have acted in good faith. During his interview Monday before the Judicial and Bar Council (JBC), Zalameda said unprogrammed appropriations are constitutional and that official acts are presumed regular unless a competent court rules otherwise. “When you say it is constitutional, I don’t think the public officers may be held liable for such an act, for an act which is declared constitutional,” said Zalameda, one of five candidates seeking to replace […]...
